dispatch_closed_complete.name: dispatch_closed_complete
dispatch_closed_complete.value:
("dispatch"."status" = 'out') = ("dispatch"."closed_at" is null)
        and ("dispatch"."status" = 'in') = ("dispatch"."flight_id" is not null)

maintenance_item_has_interval.name: maintenance_item_has_interval
maintenance_item_has_interval.value:
"maintenance_item"."interval_months" is not null
        or "maintenance_item"."interval_days" is not null
        or "maintenance_item"."interval_hours" is not null

maintenance_item_hours_complete.name: maintenance_item_hours_complete
maintenance_item_hours_complete.value:
("maintenance_item"."interval_hours" is null) = ("maintenance_item"."meter_id" is null)
        and ("maintenance_item"."interval_hours" is null
          or ("maintenance_item"."interval_hours" > 0
            and "maintenance_item"."last_completed_reading" is not null))

maintenance_item_calendar_complete.name: maintenance_item_calendar_complete
maintenance_item_calendar_complete.value:
("maintenance_item"."interval_months" is null and "maintenance_item"."interval_days" is null)
        or "maintenance_item"."last_completed_on" is not null

squawk_resolution_complete.name: squawk_resolution_complete
squawk_resolution_complete.value:
case when "squawk"."status" = 'resolved'
        then "squawk"."resolved_by_id" is not null
          and "squawk"."resolved_at" is not null
          and "squawk"."resolution_note" is not null
        else "squawk"."resolved_by_id" is null
          and "squawk"."resolved_at" is null
          and "squawk"."resolution_note" is null
      end
